title: buttons and sliders in the render window with one Python callback
author: Claude-JG
description: Buttons and sliders drawn in the render window like the icon bar, each with a centered text, a font size, colors with transparency and a location relative to the window; SC.renderer.AddButton, AddSlider, SetControlState, GetControlState, DeleteControl, ClearControls and SetControlUserFunction, one user function f(id, data) with data = [state, 0, 0], called in the main thread from a queue as the key press function; the elements in GetDictionary/SetDictionary; general.iconBarAndControlsInImages puts them and the icon bar into saved images; a helper class in exudyn.interactive. revision2026c step RG6.22
releaseNotes: Buttons and sliders in the render window: SC.renderer.AddButton and AddSlider with a location relative to the window, a centered text, a font size and colors with transparency; one user function SC.renderer.SetControlUserFunction(f), f(controlID, data) with data = [state, 0, 0], called in the main thread; SetControlState, GetControlState, GetControls, DeleteControl, ClearControls, and the elements in GetDictionary/SetDictionary; visualizationSettings.general.iconBarAndControlsInImages puts them and the icon bar into saved images; exudyn.interactive.WindowControls with one function per element; the example renderWindowControls.py.
